title: Give the auditor exact campaign-rule context parity
description:
Objective
Supply the mechanics audit model with the exact same active campaign-rule prose set used by the primary DM for the audited turn.

Required behavior
Use one deterministic active-rule context projection for both roles. The auditor evaluates canonical pack semantics plus active rulings and house rules at the turn's effective position, including a rule established at the start of an immediately replayed disputed turn. Preserve rule IDs/kinds/provenance so audit diagnostics can identify the governing campaign rule. Add direct equivalence tests over ordering, content, status filtering, supersession, revocation, and effective position.

Architecture and references
Build on the existing mechanics-audit gate eshyra-oobh and the context/storage contracts from eshyra-jhpt.1-.3. Follow ADR 0017: models interpret approved prose; deterministic code only selects the active set and timing.

Non-goals
No independent auditor-only rule registry or retrieval policy; no auditor authority to create/modify campaign rules; no arbitrary prose compilation; no changed canonical rules-pack semantics.
acceptance_criteria:
For every tested campaign position, DM and auditor receive byte-for-byte/equivalent deterministic active rule sets; superseded/revoked/future rules are absent; disputed-turn rules are present during replay; auditor diagnostics can cite rule identity; focused tests prove parity and prevent divergent context builders.

ADR 0020 TRANSITION AMENDMENT A3 (integrated transition design section 8.3, R6;
accepted as the deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8, PR #485, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282): the accepted-turn trace must retain
durable evidence of WHICH active campaign rules and rulings were supplied for the
turn and under which identities. Parity plus rule-identity citation in
diagnostics is not the same property: parity proves DM and auditor saw the same
set, while A3 proves what that set was, after the fact, from the persisted trace.

The evidence attaches to the existing accepted-turn trace authority
(memory/turnTrace.ts TurnTraceRecord). It must NOT create a second campaign-rule
store, a discovery-owned rule registry, or a parallel audit database (ADR 0017
section 8; ADR 0020 audit-architecture restraint). eshyra-jhpt.9 proves the
property end to end.

This is what lets the transition design's M5 measurement - which active rules and
rulings were requested, which matched, and which were placed beside their
governing material - be computed without a discovery-owned store. The
discovery-side consumer eshyra-o9bd.19.13 (transition W11) depends on this output
and may not substitute a discovery-local store.
notes: Delivered on branch eshyra-jhpt; PR opened https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/526 at head eeab5eb (2026-09-05). Stays in_progress until merge.
